claims.text: The local unnumbered WotC promo catalog models the CoroCoro Comic December 1998 issue insert source group with a November 15, 1998 release date.
The local source group contains four contiguous Bulbapedia raw source rows, 063 through 066: Brock's Mankey, Erika's Bulbasaur, Misty's Tentacool, and Lt. Surge's Jolteon.

The catalog treats this as an unnumbered promotional campaign source group derived from the promotion note CoroCoro Comic December 1998 issue insert (November 15, 1998), parented to the WotC-era Japanese unnumbered promo continuation slice.
This source group matters because it puts Gym Leader ownership into magazine distribution: Brock, Erika, Misty, and Lt. Surge names become identity rails, not decoration.
The local catalog explicitly says this campaign-level split is derived from a source promotion note and is not official product-boundary proof beyond that note.
The four-card group is small enough for complete hand-authored coverage; collector attention comes from Gym Leader ownership plus familiar species rather than conventional rarity.

The primary source rows do not provide illustrator authority for this unnumbered promo source slice, so this tranche leaves artist coverage unresolved rather than importing credits from other printings.

Agents should preserve the CoroCoro December 1998 distribution/source-group note, source indices 063-066, owner-prefixed card names, parent unnumbered promo continuation slice, and absence of printed set number before accepting a card-name match.
